title: U1b linked full-fixture owned-runtime profile and bounded optimization pilot evidence
scope: Diagnostic-only private source/assembly rewrites or private native runtime candidates. No production source compiler/runtime/ABI/collector policy was modified by these pilots. Five pairs were intentionally not run because no single-pair pilot showed a plausible material benefit.
verified_output: All pilot runs had identical stdout, stderr and exit status versus the independent C-bootstrap fixture. U1b profiler also passed parity and all phase-counter assertions.

profile.scope: FULL linked fixture, real owned-runtime diagnostic only; phase wall from CLOCK_MONOTONIC; GC inclusive time overlaps phases; counters instrumented; profiler speed NOT comparable to production

pilots.candidate_change: inline readonly .Lvalue_slot_count load instead of calling pure erist_rt_slots_live
pilots.scope: Same exact generated source assembly; original owned runtime vs one safe-point exact counter load. Uninstrumented process wall times include startup/OS noise. No source semantics, ABI, memory budget, collector thresholds, or root changes.

pilots.candidate_change: inline existing graph bucket hash and table selection into erist_rt_graph_find, preserve all collisions/identity
pilots.scope: Same exact generated source assembly; original owned runtime vs one safe-point exact counter load. Uninstrumented process wall times include startup/OS noise. No source semantics, ABI, memory budget, collector thresholds, or root changes.

pilots.candidate_change: cache positive exact graph pointer, invalidate at GC sweep; fall back to original collision-safe lookup on misses
pilots.scope: Same exact generated source assembly, original owned runtime versus one private, explicitly named runtime candidate. Uninstrumented native process wall times; output and exit match independent C-bootstrap. Candidate never changes source semantics, 32-byte ABI, memory admission budgets, collector schedule or root traversal policy.

interpretation: Full diagnostic wall/phase seconds have profiler overhead and are not directly comparable with uninstrumented baselines.
GC collector inclusive timing overlaps phase timing; do not add them.
One-pair pilot comparisons are insufficient to conclude sub-percent or small percent speed changes.
Uninstrumented baseline duration varied across GitHub Actions runs (roughly 62-74s); between-run numerical comparisons are not matched experiments.
No candidate demonstrated a material improvement, so no 5-pair qualification and no production optimization was promoted.
Verifier stage and generic allocator/value-slot traffic dominate, not GC collection duration; future optimization must preserve independent verification of malformed unchanged-revision IR.
Physical per-owner 8MiB peak and 64MiB traffic budgets remain unchanged; counters are runtime calls not owner capacity nor RSS.
